post.summary: Register a Team HQ Live Activity
post.description: Authenticated. Registers routing/audience data for an iOS Lock Screen / Dynamic Island match card, keyed per user + fixture + club. Requires UserSettings.liveScoreUpdates consent (403 FORBIDDEN otherwise). `activityId` is minted server-side and returned; the client enters it via OneSignal.LiveActivities.enter. `pushToken` is accepted and persisted but inert today — it exists only for a possible future direct-APNs migration and is never read by dispatch. Android (#697) returns success-nothing-to-register (`{ registered: true, platform: "android", activityId: null, expiresAt: null }`, no row written) after the same game/team/consent checks — Android Live Updates ride ordinary push subscriptions (OneSignal Create-message + NotificationServiceExtension) and need no registration.

Any other value is 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

get.description: Page mode (default): `page` + `hasMore`. Cursor mode (DSE-369): pass opaque `cursor` from a prior `nextCursor`; response includes `nextCursor` (`null` at end). Both modes return `nextCursor` (#689) — a page-1 request has no cursor to send, so page mode is where a client obtains its first one; the only exception is a viewer whose filter was remapped by #614, where a cursor would 400 on the next request and is withheld. Invalid cursor → 400 (decoded against the request filter before any #614 remap). Cursors are scope-keyed (#660): a cursor issued for one `teamId` / `phase` / `postType` / `authorTeamId` / `authorId` / `includeDemo=false` scope 400s when resumed under another scope — always restart from page 1 when the scope changes. Filters: trending|latest|following|foryou. `teamId` narrows to the per-team feed (about-tagged OR authored-as for that team); `authorTeamId` narrows to officially-as-team posts; both compose with `following` as AND. NULL-matches-any: rows with unset `channel` / `teamId` match any `phase` / `teamId` filter, so untagged posts stay in scoped feeds. When the viewer has UserSettings.analyticsPersonalization=false (#614), trending/foryou are served chronological (`latest` order) and a *valid* ranked cursor is dropped after that 400-check. Ranked filters (trending/foryou) additionally carry `rank` (absolute 0-based position, continuing across pages) and `reason` ({ code, label?, subjectId? }) per post, plus `rankVersion` on the envelope (#686) — chronological filters and opted-out viewers carry none of the three. `ads` is `[]` only when inventory is switched off; an opted-out viewer takes the contextual fill path (#687).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous nextCursor. When set, takes precedence over page. Invalid, or issued for a different filter/scope (teamId/phase/postType/authorTeamId/authorId/includeDemo) → 400.

parameters.name: authorId
parameters.description: When set, only return posts by this author

parameters.name: authorTeamId
parameters.description: When set, only return posts authored officially by this team

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: Per-team feed scope: posts about-tagged with this team, posts authored as this team, plus untagged (NULL teamId) posts per the NULL-matches-any rule. Composes with following as AND.

parameters.name: phase
parameters.description: Game-phase scope (pre|live|post), matched against the post channel. Unset channel matches any phase per the NULL-matches-any rule. Unknown values are ignored.

parameters.name: postType
parameters.description: Post-type filter (standard|hottake). hottake matches posts with isHotTake or postType=hottake; standard excludes them. Unknown values are ignored.

200.description: { success, data: { posts, hasMore, nextCursor?, rankVersion? } } — posts on ranked filters also carry `rank` and `reason` (#686)

400.description: Invalid cursor — malformed, filter mismatch, or scope mismatch (teamId/phase/postType/authorTeamId/authorId/includeDemo changed between pages). Restart from page 1. A cursor whose anchor post was deleted or aged out of the ranking window is NOT a 400: the ranked filters resume from the anchor's own sort position instead. (VALIDATION_ERROR)

suggest=1: suggested users (auth). No id: current user (auth). id and/or handle: public profile. Current-user payload always includes `interests` (array; empty means none) and `interestsCapturedAt` (ISO 8601 or null if never captured). Rep: `trophies` is the PointsHistory sum only and never changes meaning — old clients read it. `fanRep` is the combined total (PointsHistory + RepLedgerEntry) and is what new clients should read. Self payload also includes optional `config` (DSE-368 feed control plane: feedRanking, signalsEnabled, signalSampleRate, adsEnabled, adsPersonalized, experiments). `adsEnabled` is ad inventory (first-party, defaults on); `adsPersonalized` is whether that inventory may be selected from behavioural signals (#687) — the two are separate and only the second is consent-governed. When UserSettings.analyticsPersonalization is false (#614), config is forced to legacy / signals off / sample 0 / targeting off, while `adsEnabled` passes through. Omitted for other profiles / signed-out — clients use safe defaults (legacy / signals off / sample 0 / inventory on / targeting off).

get.description: Authenticated paginated user search. Default scope matches handle, name, and (for q length >= 2) location. `scope=mention` matches handle and name only and omits users without a handle — use this from @mention typeahead so a city fragment cannot outrank a handle. `limit` is accepted (1–50, default 20). Each row uses `profileUrl` (not `avatar`); there is no `level` field. `handle` is nullable on the default scope and non-empty on `scope=mention`. `location` is always returned as a profile field; only the default scope uses it for matching and ranking.

get.summary: Read the caller's locker-singularity idle ledger
get.description: First-ever read creates the ledger row. Otherwise credits offline accrual from the server lastSeenAt only (8h cap at 50% efficiency; client timestamps are never accepted) and returns { ledger, accruedBuzz, cappedHours, lastSeenAt }. Toy currencies only: zero writes to DSC balances, Rep, PointsHistory, pack inventory, or marketplace state (d-sports-api#682). The locker-singularity Game row ships as LIVE: the catalog marks it playable=true. Ledger routes serve COMING_SOON rows normally; an absent Game row returns 404 GAME_UNKNOWN with the ledger untouched. Optional X-Client-Version is checked against minClientVersion; below-minimum returns 403 GAME_UPDATE_REQUIRED. Native mirror: locker-singularity spec on the native soft-idle-mini-game branch.

post.description: The client sends intent, never values. tapCount is an integer >= 1 with no wire max; values above 100 are clamped server-side (acceptedTaps=100, clampedTaps=tapCount-100). Non-integer or non-positive counts return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. Sustained abuse returns 429 IDLE_TAP_RATE_LIMITED with a Retry-After header. Mutations carry a UUID v4 idempotencyKey: replaying the same key returns the stored response verbatim, while the same key with a mutated body returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with no second credit. Optional X-Client-Version below minClientVersion returns 403 GAME_UPDATE_REQUIRED.

post.description: quantity is an integer 1-100, else 400 IDLE_MAX_PER_CALL. Unknown generatorId returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. Locked generators (unlock thresholds unmet) return 409 IDLE_GENERATOR_LOCKED. Insufficient buzz returns 409 IDLE_INSUFFICIENT_BUZZ with no partial write. Crossing 25/50 owned per generator appends milestones and grants +1 Playbook each (max 8 per run). Idempotent per idempotencyKey. Optional X-Client-Version below minClientVersion returns 403 GAME_UPDATE_REQUIRED.

post.description: Requires lifetimeBuzz >= 1,000,000, else 409 IDLE_PRESTIGE_NOT_ELIGIBLE with no state change. Grants marginal rings: max(0, floor(sqrt(cumulativeBuzz / 1e6)) - totalRingsGranted), so repeat prestiges with no new buzz grant 0. Resets buzz, lifetimeBuzz, generators, milestones, playbooks, and upgrades; rings, totalRings, multiplier, and prestigeCount persist. Idempotent per idempotencyKey. Optional X-Client-Version below minClientVersion returns 403 GAME_UPDATE_REQUIRED.
